items.mainDefect: The legacy DeleteCollection goroutine records its timing with recordStorageDuration when it should use recordLegacyDuration.

secondary.defect: A failure of the Create storage call is recorded with recordLegacyDuration when it should use recordStorageDuration.
A failure of the Update storage call is recorded with recordLegacyDuration when it should use recordStorageDuration.
The Delete success metric passes `name` where options.Kind belongs.

items.mainDefect: Delete builds its context with klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of the enriched `log`, so the name, kind and method values are dropped.

secondary.defect: The Delete success metric passes `name` where options.Kind belongs, which gives a mislabeled, high-cardinality label.

items.mainDefect: The Mode3 tests never wait for or assert the asynchronous legacy write, so they would still pass if the legacy write were removed.

secondary.defect: The Create error test registers its failure on the legacy side through setupLegacyFn, so it does not isolate a unified-store failure.

items.mainDefect: The async legacy writes derive their context from the request ctx, which is cancelled when the handler returns, so legacy writes get aborted and legacy storage diverges from unified storage.

secondary.defect: obj is not deep-copied before the goroutine starts, so the goroutine can race with the response path.

items.mainDefect: A failure of the Update storage call is recorded with recordLegacyDuration when it should use recordStorageDuration.

secondary.defect: A failure of the Create storage call at line 45 is also recorded with recordLegacyDuration when it should use recordStorageDuration.

items.mainDefect: The Delete success metric passes the object `name` where options.Kind is expected, which gives a high-cardinality, mislabeled metric.

secondary.defect: Delete sets the context logger from d.Log instead of the enriched `log`.

items.mainDefect: Update passes the raw objInfo to Legacy.Update instead of a wrapper that carries the object storage already updated, so legacy recomputes the update against its own copy, which may differ from storage.

secondary.defect: The legacy Update error is only recorded in a metric and is never logged or returned.
